# Generation Prompt Sheet

**You Enter University to Study Computer Science — But Are You Ready for the Future?**

78 prompts, one per shot, in cut order. Each is self-contained: style, subject, camera and palette are baked in so shots can be generated independently and in parallel.

## Global negative prompt

```
No photorealistic live action, no Western/Silicon Valley campus tropes in Act A, no exaggerated sci-fi weaponry, no readable fake logos or brand marks, no dense unreadable UI text, no cluttered on-screen typography, no depiction of any language or technology as dead or obsolete
```

## Character reference

Generate one character sheet first and use it as an image reference on every shot featuring the student, otherwise the face will drift between shots.

```
19-year-old Sri Lankan student, warm brown skin, short black wavy hair, thin silver-rimmed glasses, pale blue short-sleeve collared shirt, dark navy canvas backpack, simple white canvas shoes
```
